ballooning_alpha_crit_provenance: large-aspect-ratio circular-plasma s-alpha first-stability threshold, Connor-Hastie-Taylor PRL 40, 396 (1978); screening threshold only, not shape-corrected
method: q(psi) = d(Phi_toroidal)/d(psi) via area integration on the existing axisymmetric grid; Suydam and s-alpha criteria evaluated at each resolved flux surface
limitations: Large-aspect-ratio, circular-cross-section analytic criteria; no shape/elongation/triangularity correction to the ballooning threshold.
Not a full n -> infinity ballooning eigenvalue solve; no second-stability access assessment.
Low-shear and negative-shear surfaces are excluded from the pass/fail grade, not certified stable.
Ideal MHD only: no resistive, kinetic, or non-axisymmetric (n != 0) mode assessment.
